## Releases Q3 2026

- [gsm.viz v2.4.1](https://github.com/Gilead-Public/gsm.viz/releases/tag/v2.4.1) — 2026-08-07 — This release dynamically disables bar labels to prevent overlap in the categorical axis direction, in addition to the preexisting overlap prevention in the numerical axis direction.
- [gsm.datasim v2.0.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.datasim/releases/tag/v2.0.0) — 2026-07-17 — This major release introduces a composable study builder API, longitudinal multi-snapshot study support, workflow-driven data generation, a domain registry, and parquet export.
- [gsm.qtl v1.3.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.qtl/releases/tag/v1.3.0) — 2026-07-17 — QTL workflows now run on the new `workr` engine.
- [gsm.reporting v1.1.6](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/releases/tag/v1.1.6) — 2026-07-17 — This release migrates workflow orchestration to the new `workr` package and improves how metric metadata flows through to reports.
- [gsm.kri v1.6.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.kri/releases/tag/v1.6.0) — 2026-07-17 — This minor release introduces the Premature Deaths reporting module and adds cross-study sorting and filtering capabilities.
- [gsm.mapping v1.1.5](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.mapping/releases/tag/v1.1.5) — 2026-07-17 — This release migrates query execution and workflow discovery to the new `workr` package and includes mapping and documentation improvements.
- [workr v1.1.0](https://github.com/Gilead-Public/workr/releases/tag/v1.1.0) — 2026-07-17 — Improved project orchestration with phase-level configuration files,
- [gsm.core v1.3.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.core/releases/tag/v1.3.0) — 2026-07-17 — This minor release moves the workflow runtime to the new `{workr}` package and adds the `deathcls` column to the Death domain in `lSource`.
- [gsm.viz v2.4.0](https://github.com/Gilead-Public/gsm.viz/releases/tag/v2.4.0) — 2026-07-14 — A brand-new ggplot2-aligned declarative bar chart module (`bars`) that reproduces disparate bar chart implementations across the `gsm` ecosystem, including most functionality in the existing, KRI-specific `barChart` module (#502, #482).

- [gsm.mapping v1.1.3](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.mapping/releases/tag/v1.1.3) — 2026-04-15 — This minor update includes new/updated domain mapping specs, improved mapping documentation, and expanded qualification/unit testing and CI workflows.
- [workr v1.0.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/workr/releases/tag/v1.0.0) — 2026-04-09 — {workr} provides a minimal framework for describing and executing step-by-step R data pipelines using YAML-defined workflows.

- [gsm.mapping v1.0.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.mapping/releases/tag/v1.0.0) — 2025-03-14 — We are excited to announce the first major release of the `gsm.mapping` package, which contains essential mapping-specific functions and workflows for the GSM (Good Statistical Modeling) pipeline.
- [gsm.kri v1.0.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.kri/releases/tag/v1.0.0) — 2025-03-14 — We are happy to announce the first major release of the `gsm.kri` package, which houses the metric and module workflows, as well as all visualization functions and widgets for the GSM pipeline.
- [gsm.reporting v1.0.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/releases/tag/v1.0.0) — 2025-03-14 — We are pleased to introduce the first major release of the `gsm.reporting` package, which powers the GSM reporting data model and orchestrates the workflows for generating reports within the GSM pipeline.
- [gsm.viz v2.2.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.viz/releases/tag/v2.2.0) — 2025-03-06 — v2.2.0 is the first open-source release of this repo 🎉 The package has been renamed `gsm.viz` from `rbm-viz` to align with other packages in the [OpenRBQM universe](https://openrbqm.github.io/packages.html).
- [gsm.viz v2.1.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.viz/releases/tag/v2.1.0) — 2025-03-04 — v2.1.0 extends the click event functionality with a new custom event named `riskSignalSelected`.
- [gsm.qc v0.0.1](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.qc/releases/tag/v0.0.1) — 2025-02-26 — Initial release of qualification package for testing gsm packages.
- [gsm.mapping v0.0.2](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.mapping/releases/tag/v0.0.2) — 2025-02-05 — This second release ensures that only the mapping-related functions, workflows, widgets and documentation from `{gsm}` to `{gsm.mapping}`.
- [gsm.kri v0.0.1](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.kri/releases/tag/v0.0.1) — 2025-02-05 — This initial release migrates the KRI-specific functions, workflows, widgets and documentation from {gsm} to {gsm.kri}.
- [gsm.reporting v0.0.1](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.reporting/releases/tag/v0.0.1) — 2025-02-05 — First release of `{gsm.reporting}`, which migrates the functions, workflows, documentation and vignette to produce the reporting data model for gsm reports
- [gsm.app v2.3.0](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.app/releases/tag/v2.3.0) — 2025-01-29 — Apps now feature site-level domain details!
